text.en:
The Department of Budget and Management shall remit
directly to the Government Service Insurance System quarterly the local government
unit's shares as well as the employee contributions due under Republic Act No. 8291,
Republic Act No. 6111 and Presidential Decree No. 626, as amended.
~JEE Hologram
-

The amount corresponding to the said premium contributions
shall be deducted from the Internal Revenue Allotment (IRA) of Local Government
Units concerned.
The outstanding compulsory contributions and other
remittances of LGUs due the concerned government agencies, GFls, and GOCCs
shall likewise be deducted from the IRA of LGU concerned.

For the effective implementation of this Order, the concerned
national government agencies, GFls and GOCCs may enter in~o an appropriate
Memorandum of Agreement with the DBM. The Local Government Units shall
submit to the DBM a list of their existing personnel covered under the Insurance
System, the individual contributions (government and employee share), together with
the list of delayed remittances due the national government agencies, GFls, and
GOCCs. Failure of the LGU officials and/or employees to submit such listing and
other requirement shall be a basis for appropriate disciplinary action and sanction.

For the guidance of all local government units and to ensure
full compliance of this Order, the Department of Budget and Management shall issue
the necessary implementing rules and regulation for the purpose.

This Executive Order shall take effect on January 1,2000.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 21 st day of December, in the Year of Our
Lord, Nineteen HWldred and Ninety Nine.
